transcription.text: Important notification. This call is from the Investigation Division of the Australian Border Force.
The reason behind this call is that the Australian Border Force has found and seized a parcel under your name,
which was shipped through an Australian post, using your ID, which contains a legal component.
There is an arrest warrant already issued under your name.
To talk to an officer from the Australian Border, please press 1 now. I repeat, press 1.
Oh no! A legal component! What is it? Is it a variant of the 555?
